method.Method: Intersections of FDOT arterial/collector roads (functional class ['04', '06', '07', '08', '14', '16', '17', '18']), clustered within 150 m; interstates, expressways and local streets excluded. 2,810 in pilot counties.
2+ miles from any 7-Eleven/Speedway fuel store (FDEP + 7-Eleven API; non-fuel stores do not trigger it). 707 pass. Curb cut on each road is implied by intersection; Luke verifies.

Shown by default only if a raw parcel of 1.3+ acres touches the corner (within 50 m): vacant residential/commercial/industrial/institutional or acreage with no buildings, or agricultural land; FL DOR 2026 tax roll. Excludes public, conservation, HOA/CDD and very low-value remnant parcels (ponds, buffers). Approved by Ross Nov 11, 2026 after the build-to-suit land check: ~72% of Florida 7-Eleven BTS deals (rent $350K+) were built on raw land. Turn the filter off to see redevelopment corners. A top-60 aerial check removed 3 corners with no raw land visible.
new_rooftops 25, rooftop_pipeline 5, new_grocery 10, traffic 35, gap_to_7eleven 5, retail_node 10, signal 10 (model v1.2, approved None).
Residential units with DOR actual year built 2023-2025 within 3 miles; scored as percentile among pilot intersections.
Vacant residential parcels under 0.5 ac (platted lots) within 3 miles; percentile. INFERENCE: proxy for approved subdivisions.
Grocers (Publix, Aldi, Winn-Dixie, Whole Foods, Trader Joe's, Sprouts) on parcels built 2023+ within 3 miles; 0, 1, 2+. INFERENCE from parcel year built; "coming soon" stores not yet included.
Sum of the highest FDOT 2025 AADT on the two busiest roadways within 60 m (interstates/expressways excluded); percentile. No count = neutral (0.5), not zero.
Distance to nearest 7-Eleven fuel store: 0 at 2 mi, full points at 5+ mi.

Within 1/2 mile: anchors (Walmart, Publix, Target, Home Depot, Lowe's, Costco, Sam's, Aldi, Winn-Dixie, Tractor Supply) 60%, nationals (McDonald's, Starbucks, Dollar General) 40%. Walmart/Lowe's data incomplete.
FDOT signal within 60 m = full; no FDOT signal on roads FDOT tracks = 0; roads FDOT doesn't track = unknown (half).
Within the default raw-land pool: A = top 15% of score, B = next 25%, C = rest. Redevelopment corners keep their tier among all candidates.
Highest scores among raw-land corners (after the aerial check), no two within 1 mile of each other.

Each pilot 7-Eleven built 2018+ scored at its own location (its own store excluded from the gap) and ranked against all pilot intersections. CAVEAT: uses today's rooftop counts, not those at the time 7-Eleven chose the site.
Built 2026-11-17. See 7-Eleven Source Data - Pilot.xlsx, Sources & Dates.
